ꜣgb: ꜣgb — flood, flood-water, inundation (noun m.; written with three lines of water; Budge: aḳab 'the water floods')
ngg-wr: ngg-wr — the Great Cackler, a goose of the beginning of things, whose egg the speaker claims to be (god's name; from ngg 'cackle' + wr 'great'; Budge: Neḳeḳ-ur)
nḫt: nḫt — to be strong, be mighty (verb 3-lit.; classifier of force; not to be confused with nḫḫ 'grow old'; Budge: neχeχt 'grow strong')
ssn: ssn — to breathe, smell (verb 3-lit.; written with the nose as classifier; Budge: sesen 'smell')
wḏꜥ-ꜣꜥb: wḏꜥ-ꜣꜥb — Wedja-aab, a being addressed by name; the name is not understood (?) (name; first part perhaps wḏꜥ 'judge, separate', second part ꜣꜥb not known; Budge: Utā-aāb, 'Utcha-aāb')
bkꜣ: bkꜣ — to dawn, grow light (?) (verb; the sun as classifier; the same letters also spell bkꜣ 'be pregnant'; sense uncertain here; Budge: 'destroy (?)')

__broaden__.nḏm: nḏm — to be sweet, pleasant (verb; nḏm ib 'glad of heart'; Budge: net'em) · also the adjective used as a noun, 'the sweet one'
